![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Pass the collected `diagnostics` array to `buildValidatorResult` so that any malformed entries or file load failures can be checked and flagged as validation failures.

```suggestion
  const validatorResult = buildValidatorResult({ sourceMap, root, paths, generatedAt, diagnostics });
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When loading parsed files (such as JSON), validate the parsed file shape, record malformed entry diagnostics, skip bad entries, and pass those diagnostics into the package validator to ensure it fails closed.
</details>

Fixed in 669ec2b8f. The validator now includes `no_malformed_input_entries`, fails when critical malformed-entry or input-load diagnostics exist, and the checked-in validator artifact has the passing zero-diagnostic result for the canonical inputs.

Fixed in 669ec2b8f. `buildRows` now validates each plain-text item, records `malformed_plain_text_item` diagnostics for non-object or missing-field entries, skips malformed entries, and preserves original JSON pointers for valid rows. Added regression coverage for malformed plain-text entries.

Fixed in 669ec2b8f. Input loading now uses safe JSON reads that record `input_file_load_failed` diagnostics for missing or malformed critical files and return empty fallback inputs, so the package fails validation instead of crashing. Added missing/malformed input-file regression coverage.

Fixed in 669ec2b8f. The diagnostics array is now threaded through input loading, row building, `sourceMap.input_diagnostics`, `buildSummary`, and `buildValidatorResult`, so malformed rows and file-load failures are surfaced as validator failures.
